lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Ti2Cu2 (Mg6TiCu) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows that all Cu, Mg, and Ti centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.88 to 3.23 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Cu- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
